lead.hed: USNI: two mariners dead in Hormuz. A casualty count is not an open strait.
lead.insight: USNI, posted overnight: two mariners were killed in the past week and a half in the Strait of Hormuz by Iranian attacks. Monday’s hit on MV Minoan Dignity left one seafarer dead — the second attack on a ship managed by Greece’s Modion Maritime Management after Aug. 3’s MV Minoan Pioneer. Transits ticked up. Two dead is not a cleared lane. A small increase is not a restored corridor.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9799094 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · U.S. Navy warships transit the Arabian Sea in close formation, June 30, 2026. Caption must say June 30 Arabian Sea, not today’s Hormuz attack.
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Navy DVIDS still of a June 30, 2026 CENTCOM / Arabian Sea formation. Same-subject class as the Hormuz corridor file — not a tanker hit photo, not Friday’s Northern Viking ceremony, not a brand tile.

political.hed: USNI: Taiwan MPs drill Taipei. A metro storm-out is not a war plan.
political.insight: USNI, Friday: two ROC Military Police platoons left Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center metro in torrential rain and new grey camo, then set crew-served machine guns. A drill is not the defense of the capital. A photo line is not an order.

political.hed: Heritage: tariff the Chinese cargo ship. A levy is not a yard-sale tax.
political.insight: Heritage, Friday: the administration is adapting tariffs to spare household budgets — hit the Chinese cargo ship, not the American consignment shop. A commentary is not a customs rule. Affordability talk is not a signed annex.

tech.hed: Defense News: India asked into France’s sixth-gen jet. Talks are not a workshare.
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday 12:52: India’s Defense Ministry told parliament it has “initiated efforts in a concerted manner to co-join” France’s Future Combat Air System after Paris and Berlin dropped their joint fighter. Talks are not IP. A mock-up is not a jet.

tech.hed: USNI Pulse: North Korea lofted about 10 SRBMs. A count is not a campaign.
tech.insight: USNI Friday Western Pacific Pulse: North Korea launched about 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the Sea of Japan Thursday at 5 p.m., South Korea’s Joint Chiefs said. A weekly pulse is not a Pentagon confirm. Ten launches are not a new war.

tech.hed: Defense News: the Iran war exposed Navy tempo. A hull swap is not a fleet.
tech.insight: Defense News / Military Times, Thursday: GW arrived in the Middle East Wednesday to replace Abraham Lincoln; the western Pacific is temporarily without a U.S. carrier. The Navy is still an 11-carrier force. A relief is not a rebuilt rotation. Sailor strain is not a press release.

culture.hed: WORLD: Smith’s luminous dark. Mystical unknowing is not the gospel.
culture.insight: WORLD, Thursday: James K.A. Smith’s new Yale book asks readers to dwell in mystical non-knowing after a midlife crisis. The review’s point: union with God is through the knowable Mediator, not a cloud that erases revelation. A mood is not a creed. Certainty about Christ is not pride.

watch.hed: WATCH: Northern Viking is still underway. An opening ceremony is not today’s lead.
watch.insight: USNI Thursday file, Friday PM lead, retired Saturday AM: U.S., Iceland, and NATO began biennial Northern Viking 2026 on Tuesday; it runs through Sept. 3. Seventy-fifth year of the 1951 defense agreement. A kickoff is not a GIUK garrison. The Saturday clock is Hormuz.
